steps.content: The crimson curtains are drawn open, revealing the seats filled with audience.
You're certain you've seen this scene before.
You have experienced the same dream before the interrogation. As you've been expecting, you hear the announcer's voice behind you.

steps.speaker: Announcer
steps.content: Coming up next is a solo dance!
Clack. The spotlight shoots out a burning beam, scorching the top of your head.

The audience is going to turn into jellyfish-shaped phantoms and charge at you. You prepare yourself mentally. The spiritual link doesn't happen without a reason. She must have recalled an important past event, and perhaps the cause of her perplexity lies here.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: That's the legendary dancer?
No charging phantoms. This time, the dream seems slightly nuanced, the audience is only murmuring among themselves.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: We're watching the show to celebrate our anniversary, why is she pulling a long face?

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Well, dance! Don't just stand around!

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Think you're too famous to dance for ordinary people like us?

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Where's the music? Let the show begin, entertain me!

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: What's that sulky face for? How unpleasant! Get *** off the stage if you're not gonna dance!
The audience keeps chattering and the spiritual link is throbbing lightly, synchronizing the discomfort of the dream's owner with your senses.
What's the matter, my child? They're all here for you, go on, dance for them.
A well-dressed woman emerges from behind the curtain.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Mother... What they want is a decadent dance full of joy and pleasure.

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: So what? Just give them the dance they want. You're a genius, I know it. You can bring any kind of dance to reality!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: But sad melodies are floating everywhere in the world. How shall I dance for joy?
You follow the gaze of the dream's owner. Bluish-purple smoke flows before your eyes, forms a familiar ring shape, then suddenly shatters, dispersing in the air as tiny specks of sadness.
Is this the pseudo-illusion Hamel had been able to see growing up?

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Shush, never mention that again! I don't care what filthy thing the great explosion of DisSea has made you see. Promise me, never speak a word about it. You're a great dancer, we can't let them see you as a lunatic...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: But...
Hamel wants to say something more, but her mother has already reached out eagerly from behind the curtain and pushes her onto the stage.
Vibrant drum beats begin at the next second, and the dream's owner is forced to present herself on the stage.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: One, two, three, four...
As Hamel is counting the beats silently, your perspective keeps spinning joyously following Hamel's movements.
You see that wherever her sleeves pass, a bluish-purple mist rises, and the stage is becoming blurry and dreamy in Hamel's eyes. A familiar figure forms amid the mist.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: You were born to dance. Dancing is your way of connecting to the world. You perceive everything with your body. Yet, what have you truly perceived?

The dream's owner is moving back and forth amid the mist, feeling the flow of the air with her fingers. The sadness she feels with her fingertips and the joy of the music are grappling in her veins. She's only keeping her steps orderly relying on muscle memory.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Broken, sad... This is what you want to narrate, what the great explosion has left this city with... but this is not what they wish to see.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Bravo! Praises for the legendary dancer's expressiveness are no exaggeration!
The colorful mist has grown a little dimmer, and the dance moves are gradually growing weak.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Do you remember their faces? They don't understand, and they don't want to understand... A medium to numb themselves with, a tool to help them escape from reality. That's what you are to them, nothing more.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Keep dancing! One more! One more!
The illusory mist has mostly vanished. Cheers and applause have almost covered the music of the dance.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Is this your art? Is this the dance you want?

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: My good daughter, dance well, bring me so much wealth with your dance so I can be rich for the rest of my life...
The mist is gone, and reality has become extremely clear.

Your perspective is no longer spinning joyously, and you can't feel the most sentimental desire in her blood anymore. All the urge to express broken beauty has been defeated in this grapple with false joy. Hamel halts her steps.
Her gaze passes over the smirking faces in the audience who have convinced themselves they're happy. She wobbles.
Thump!
She falls under the spotlights.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Have you found the answer? Why did you choose the Black Ring? Why did you stay there?
In the dark, the phantom brushes against Hamel's face.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: There's no place for you in the outside world. Go back, you can only find what you truly desire there.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Go back, go back...
The scene changes. A dazzling light refracted through the ice surface leads you into the next dream.
The stage at the center of the lake in the Carnival?
This is a place both you and Hamel know very well. Black jellyfish are frozen above the center of the lake, as if they've been waiting for Hamel to return.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Will I find the answer by coming back here?

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Of course, do you not trust me?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It's just that, you're an illusion that's only recently appeared in my dreams...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: No...
The phantom closes in on Hamel.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: I've always been by your side.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The dancer doesn't need to be greeted. She only needs to dance. We will be your audience.

Townspeople
Well, dance! Don't just stand around!

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: Once I see your dance, my heart regains peace.

Audience
Where's the music? Let the show begin, entertain me!

steps.speaker: Fear Puppet
steps.content: All our unspeakable sorrow, all our inexpressible pain, you understand them and empathize with us, mourning on behalf of us with your dance.

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content:
Mother
Freak, lunatic...

Corruptor
Dance, Hamel, dance... Use your dancing... to make our dreams a reality!

steps.speaker: Younger Brother
steps.content:
Younger Brother
Stop dancing, Sister!

Corruptor
Thank you, we love you...
Plunk!
You hear the sound of someone diving to the bottom of the lake. Bone-chilling ice water rushes into your mouth and nose. A despairing feeling of suffocation drags you back to reality.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: That's right, you've always been by my side... What I truly desire... The reason I couldn't bring myself to leave...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Always been here...
I know what it is that Hamel truly desires...

Dancing is the most straightforward aesthetic exchange between the audience and the dancer. Hamel's dance of brokenness will never be accepted by the ostentatious big stages in the DisCity. The only beings that will accept her are...
Corruptors who have also experienced brokenness.

The dream was very long. It's already past midnight now, and most people in the Bureau are already in their sleep, but you can't suppress the urge to share your conclusion. You must tell Hamel the entire answer as soon as possible.
Hopefully... she still remembers what she saw in her dream.
But you arrive at the detention area of the Sinners only to find Hamel's room empty.

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Warning! Warning! Sinner S-008 has gone missing! All guards please search every section of the Bureau!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! Your guess is correct. Hamel has indeed gone in the direction of the Carnival.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Besides, we've detected that the Corruptors scattered along the Rust seem to have received some kind of summoning and are converging on the Carnival!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I've contacted all the available police forces we can mobilize along the way, to slow her down as much as possible and minimize the impact of the loitering Corruptors on scavenging civilians along the Rust.
Corruptors... Audiences...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You don't look well. Is it because you got startled out of sleep? Or is it the shackles...
No, there's nothing wrong with the shackles. I've just got something on my own mind...

The audience treated her as an entertaining plaything. Her family alienated her and treated her as a cash cow. The public only cared about her gossip. Even the Bureau... has only treated her as a Sinner with a very high risk.
Just like she was determined to stay inside the Black Ring, now she wants to escape from reality and return to her final stage.
Are you really going to stop her?
